notes: Screening only. This set has no reserve-margin, transmission, curtailment, or build-rate constraints.
Not policy-grade. Results may be labelled screening or diagnostic, never policy or forecast.
The 5% PWRBIO cap, 0 GW nuclear cap, +$3/GJ wind adder, and 20% zonal wind cap are scenario assumptions, not policy.
The RSYC-only supply curve has no AAC, THLB, operability, or local correction.
A future policy_test_v1 is a distinct set. It is not defined here and screening_v0 must not be relabelled as policy-grade.

feasibility_notes: 150 Mm3 is the adopted high scenario bound and is 7.34 Mm3 below the partial AAC sum, but the status-quo provincial mix exceeds the BC repo AAC (3.79 Mm3; 5.64 against the 2028+ hold), NB Crown AAC (5.54 Mm3), NB NFD (2.19 Mm3), NS Crown AAC (1.21 Mm3; under the combined Crown+private ceiling), and the NT proxy (0.01 Mm3).
No provincial harvest allocation model exists. The national bound is conditional, not a feasible provincial-mix case.
NB, NS, and QC report Crown AAC while FSD harvest is total provincial harvest; a total-harvest/Crown-AAC comparison is not automatically an AAC breach.
The 157.34 Mm3 AAC sum is partial and mixed-basis (MB, PE, and NU are missing); it is not a legal national AAC.
Harvest is exogenous and free in the energy objective; this is not a policy or Pareto frontier.
